_comment_block: Tap = block_1 (raise + brief hold). block_2 is the un-block (lower-shield) animation. Held-block state machine in main.cpp owns the raise/idle/lower flow; these chain entries are a fallback for tap-fire when held-block is not active. Cancel-open auto-detects from the off-hand (left hand) velocity scan since the buckler is held in the off-hand.
